newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Azomures helps Bucharest bourse higher.
newsitem.headline: Azomures helps Bucharest bourse higher.

text.p: Turnover on the Bucharest bourse on Tuesday rose sharply to 2.1 billion lei from 112 million on the back of heavy trading in Azomures, rejoining the market after suspension, and newcomer Oltchim.
Volumes climbed to a record 1.3 million shares, although three of the 20 stocks had no trade.

Azomures SA fertiliser maker -- suspended last Thursday after a split of its shares to 1,000 lei from 25,000 each -- took 89 percent of turnover. A new price was set for Azomures, in line with the new face value of its shares, with the stock closing at 1,600 lei, 200 up on its opening quote.
"With Azomures again in the market and with a newcomer following in its footsteps there's every reason to believe in a rosy future for the stock exchange," said one trader.
Oltchim SA, a chemical plant which joined the first tier along Azomures, traded 52,870 shares and had 79.5 million lei in turnover. It closed at 1,520, 20 up on the opening.
"Oltchim is a profitable, liquid company, one in which foreigners will take an interest soon," a broker said.
Large Azomures and Oltchim volumes pushed two independent capitalisation-weighted indices to year highs.
Buyers also focused on Artrom SA engineering company, which had 37.4 million lei in turnover and closed 150 lei stronger at 3,900.
"There was a nice turnover level, of some 28 million, also in Sanevit, back to the market after months," a trader said.

Sanevit SA syringe maker, suspended last November, was readmitted to trading on Tuesday after releasing an announcement on its latest shareholders' meeting. It closed at 9,900 lei, compared with 9,100 before suspension.
Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- climbed to year highs, rising 13.3 and respectively 13.72 percent from the previous session.
